item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00439","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C05","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: it is a recent emergency-board order from the same administration concerning an airline dispute, and the child reproduces virtually the entire recital structure, operative sequence, thirty-day reporting requirement, and section 10 status-quo provision, with the carrier, union, and limited wording adjusted. C05 is even more recent and closely matches the child's phrasing, but C02 is the stronger substantive analogue because it likewise concerns an airline. C08 is especially close in naming the same carrier, but its older wording retains several features the child omits, including “said dispute.”","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Trans World Airlines, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Transport Workers Union of America, AFL-CIO, a labor organization","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pan American World Airways, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Flight Engineers' International Association, PAA Chapter, a labor organization","explanation":"The child uses the same detailed party-identification sentence and substitutes the airline and employee representative."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce","explanation":"The statutory and factual predicates are reproduced verbatim as an ordered pair of recitals."},{"child_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","explanation":"The reporting provision is identical."},{"child_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made","parent_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made","explanation":"The child reproduces the same legal mechanism and operative language for preserving the status quo."}]}
